pages-and-trees.title: Pages, trees and regions
pages-and-trees.intro: A page is a row (slug, title, status, frame, SEO) plus a tree (`splash.tree/3`) of nodes. Header, footer, above and below are regions: their trees live on pages named `region-*`, and `region.read` gives their root ids. Every node edit is a `tree.commit` of `splash.ops/2` ops.

components-and-presets.title: Site components, presets and effects
components-and-presets.intro: Presets are insertable copies (theme presets and the site's own library). Site components are reusable subtrees with exposed props: every instance follows the component. Effects are saved visual effects nodes can use.

design-system.title: Design system
design-system.intro: Tokens in sets, themes that stack sets, component variants and their cells, mixins. Every write passes the AA contrast gate in every theme on the batch's end state.

brand.title: Brand setup, identity and brand formats
brand.intro: `brand.setup` derives the whole token set of a brand (palettes, roles, type, space, radii) from a few inputs, as the admin's Brand setup screen does. The other `brand.*` operations manage the brand identity, format presets and templates, and render brand images.

navigation.title: Menus
navigation.intro: Menus are keyed lists of items that target a page, an anchor on a page, or a URL. Navbar and footer components show a menu by its key.

blogs-and-articles.title: Blogs, articles and page templates
blogs-and-articles.intro: A blog is an index page with its articles; an article is a page with its own publish state. Both render through a page template: `template.index` (the `templates` resource) lists the `templateId`s, what each template draws around the page's own tree and which parts it locks.

collections.title: Collections and items
collections.intro: Collections are typed content lists (fields, items, statuses). Repeaters on pages read them (`source=` in the outline).

forms-and-members.title: Forms, submissions and members
forms-and-members.intro: Forms collect submissions; members are the site's signed-in visitors with roles that gate content (`visibleTo`).

media-and-fonts.title: Media library and fonts
media-and-fonts.intro: Images and files live in the media library; nodes reference them as `{ "$media": "<id>" }`. Fonts are site font faces (uploaded or imported from Google Fonts) that font-family tokens name.

motion.title: Motion and scenes
motion.intro: Scenes animate nodes on scroll, on load or on interaction. Prefer recipes (`motion.listRecipes`, `motion.applyRecipe`) to hand-written scenes, and read `motion.diagnose` findings after every change.

site-and-settings.title: Site, settings, languages, redirects, access and domains
site-and-settings.intro: Site-wide configuration. Most writes here need `site.admin` (platform admin only): an editor or workspace owner token gets 403.

publication-and-history.title: Publication, versions and history
publication-and-history.intro: Publishing snapshots the draft into a live version. History records every committed batch with its inverse, so `history.undo` reverses a batch. Provider operations (domains, publication effects) leave an external request that `external.status` / `external.close` inspect.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.intro: A ticket reports a problem to the platform owner: a bug, a missing capability, a refusal that looks wrong, a docs gap. The `report_issue` tool files one in a single call (it wraps `ticket.create`); `ticket.list` and the `tickets` resource read your own tickets on this site with their status and the owner's close note. Nothing on the site changes. See the `libretto-report-issue` skill for when to file one.
